title: Tush In The Sand Cottage Seaside, FL
meta_description: Bright and cheery Leeward creates a colorful backdrop for your beach vacation, with an impressive trio of porches for multiple floors of outdoor living, dining and views.
description_expanded: Description759 FOREST STREET2 QUEENSA Bright & Cheerful Seaside Cottage with Multiple PorchesBright, colorful, and full of coastal charm, Tush In The Sand provides the perfect backdrop for a relaxed Seaside beach vacation. With an impressive trio of porches spanning multiple levels, this inviting cottage offers exceptional outdoor living, dining, and scenic views. Guests are welcomed by a delightful front porch with rocking chairs, instantly setting an easy-going, laid-back tone for their stay.Comfortable First-Floor Bedrooms with Private BathsThe first floor features two queen-sized bedrooms, each with a private bathroom. Cheerful, complementary color palettes and crisp white accents create a light and welcoming atmosphere, making these rooms ideal retreats after a day in the sun.Light-Filled Living & Updated Kitchen on the Main LevelA charming staircase leads to the main living level, where a cozy living room is bathed in natural light, creating a warm and inviting gathering space. The recently updated kitchen offers just the right amount of space for vacation cooking, featuring refreshed countertops, built-in shelving, and everything needed to prepare family meals with ease. Adjacent to the kitchen, the dining area provides a comfortable setting for casual meals while overlooking one of the home’s standout features. For added space and fresh air, glass doors open to a private outdoor area surrounded by treetop views, offering both privacy and a peaceful connection to nature.Private Tower Porch with Elevated Seaside ViewsFor the most memorable views, climb the unique ladder-style stairway to the home’s furnished tower porch. Whether enjoying morning coffee above the rooftops or taking in a magical Seaside sunset, this elevated retreat adds a special touch—blending relaxation, comfort, and a true sense of escape.A Prime Location for a Classic Seaside GetawayConveniently located near Seaside’s swimming and recreation amenities, Tush In The Sand is an exceptional choice for guests seeking a charming, colorful cottage in the heart of Seaside, Florida. With its inviting design, multiple outdoor spaces, and relaxed coastal vibe, this home is sure to rise to the top of your Seaside vacation wishlist.Must be 25 years of age to rent and sign the registration. 3-night minimum Spring, Spring Break | 5-night minimum Summer | 3-night minimum Fall | 2-night minimum WinterFEATURES968 square feet of thoughtfully designed living spaceAccess to the Seaside Private Residential Beach at Pensacola Pavilion3-minute walk (176 yards) to beach accessPrivate tower offering scenic Seaside viewsPole-mounted grill for easy outdoor mealsWasher and dryer for guest conveniencePeacock Alley linens, featuring fresh, luxurious sheets and plush towels throughout the homeAccess to 3 community swimming pools, 5 clay tennis courts, and 3 pickleball courts (court fees apply), along with a fitness centerWelcome tote with two beach towels, a complimentary bottle of wine, and two complimentary rental bikes for pickup at the Seaside Transit AuthorityPersonalized guest service throughout your stayParking policy: One parking pass is issued for one-bedroom cottages; two parking passes are issued for two-bedroom and larger homes. Golf carts are considered vehiclesGolf cart policy: Golf carts are not permitted for non-homeowners visiting Seaside. Special circumstances or medical needs require an approved golf cart permitNo pets allowedSTR23-002354
